resources.string: Use 2–6 rendered photos (JPEG, HEIF or PNG) of the same group from the same viewpoint. The first photo is the reference. Choose a real source frame for each face, ordered left to right. Background alignment and face pose checks exclude incompatible choices. This associates positions, not identities: confirm that each replacement is the intended person.
No compatible alternative for this face. Keep the reference.

Original-resolution export checks memory and fails rather than shrinking. Uncheck to explicitly save the preview dimensions (up to 2048 px). Only real aligned face pixels are feathered; inspect skin edges, gaze and seams before saving. Originals stay unchanged.

Could not prepare or save this merge. Use equal-sized photos with clear frontal faces, textured stationary backgrounds and similar lighting. For memory limits, explicitly choose preview-size export. Large pose changes, crossing people and unclear alignment are unsupported.
